blocks.x: Each Fleet Management System deployment starts with one decision class in production — not a program of twenty. The evidence pack grows with the rollout, so by the time the third use case goes live, the audit story is already routine.

Operators see Fleet Management System as one more decision surface with one difference: every recommendation carries its evidence, and every override is logged with a reason. The rollout order differs by industry; the operator experience does not — fewer surprises, faster answers, and a trail that makes the post-incident review short.
Talk to the team that runs a working session on Fleet Management System in production — the briefing is technical by design, and the first one costs nothing but the hour.
